settings.editor: Top Notch Painting is a division of Top Notch Logworks, which has built log and timber homes and resorts here since 1999. We know what it takes to make a log finish last.

background_image.alt: Freshly stained cedar fence and gate

settings.editor:
If you want your home to look its best and get the longest life from a finish, everything depends on how the logs are prepared before any stain goes on. Skipping prep cuts the life of a finish short, and you end up paying to refinish sooner.

Colorado's dry climate doesn't protect logs. Intense UV breaks down finishes and wood, letting moisture in. We use products from Sashco and Perma-Chink, made specifically for log and timber homes, and we're trained and certified to apply them.

• Media blasting to remove old, failing finishes
  • Chemical cleaning and brightening
  • Sanding and stripping where needed
  • Color samples on your own logs before you choose
  • Preservatives, stains and topcoats from Sashco and Perma-Chink
We look at the whole home: finish condition, checks, chinking and any signs of rot.
Media blasting, cleaning, brightening and sanding take the logs back to clean wood.
Preservative, stain and topcoat applied to the manufacturer's specifications.
We'll tell you honestly when the next maintenance coat is due, so small jobs stay small.
